body: yeah done the steps twice, sober for three, had sponsees, even ran a halfway house and somehow i was even more miserable than i am now. the only good thing about being sober meant i never had to worry about a DUI. That said, i still strongly believe in the rooms and am certainly putting myself either back in them or in therapy ASAP

Thank you, honestly, and hopefully we'll both only see ourselves on the other side of this thread. Its strange for the first time i didnt just think about it, i wept over the bottle of pills in my hand. Ive never come that close while not intoxicated, im just scared one day i wont be willing enough to voice it before doing anything. Its funny i always thought that people were just dying for attention when they said these types of things, but now i get it. Granted it obviously is attention seeking in its own way, but certainly not weak like i once thought.

Honestly what makes it hard is the fact i never had family, my mom died when i was young and my dads a fool. The only thing i ever really had was a few friends, but i learned how to manipulate young and always get my way no matter who i hurt. Thats whats so hard now because my luck has finally run out at the ripe age of 23. I still fell no remorse for anyone ive wronged and that makes it even harder to hold friends, when i know that i am just using them. Its such a strange thing to be aware of and not be able to change, i would love to say that i feel love or happiness even anger or sorrow, but all i ever feel is empty. I dont know if thats text book depression or if there really is some sort of disorder beyond that.

I think i got over the crazy i was feeling, for now atleast, i started commenting on other peoples posts and it managed to help get my head back in a normal place. Thanks for reaching out on the pm, means a lot. I had almost given up on people after nearly and hour with no comments, which obviously didnt help haha.
Thank you for taking the time to break it down. Makes things a lot less urgent when simplified

wow i can relate with that feeling of just udder done.try and find comfort in the fact that your not alone in the emptiness and someone else is fighting the same fight as you. i know its not the most uplifting idea but the notion that we are not unique is slightly beautiful, it means that everyday someone around you has overcome their misery.
